detail: 1: WP1.2: ERE translator and the differential's runner

1: hooks/lib/ai_ere.py, the parser (spec D3): a byte-level tokenizer over the pattern's UTF-8 bytes (C-locale semantics, H2/D6) and bracket expressions. [[:class:]] is an ASCII set, [[:space:]] is [ \t\n\v\f\r]; a backslash inside brackets is literal; []a], [^]a] and a trailing '-' are handled; single-character [[=c=]] and [[.c.]] are accepted, as range endpoints too; bad ranges, '-' as a non-final range start, a class or equivalence class as a range endpoint, unknown classes, multi-character [[
1.2: 291 > 250: the parser's unit cases, their wrapper and the run-all entry become their own step; the parser stays in step 1

2: hooks/lib/ai_ere.py, translate and compile: the GNU escapes \w \W \s \S \b \B \< \> \` \' as explicit ASCII sets and lookarounds (re.ASCII); back-references \1-\9 to a completed group, emitted as (?:\N); stacked quantifiers wrapped, so a+? and a*? become (?:a+)?; '.' with DOTALL and '$' as \Z (no REG_NEWLINE); a lone ')' is literal; invalid forms compile to None, which never matches: a leading *, + , ? or {, a quantifier after an anchor, (?, a bad interval, a trailing backslash, an unmatched

3: tests/test_pattern_differential.py, the oracle and the runner (D4 ii): one long-lived bash per locale (C, C.UTF-8; a missing locale is skipped with one line) reads NUL-delimited pattern/subject records and answers through [[ $s =~ $p ]] (rc 0/1/2 = match/no match/invalid); the verdict is compared with ai_ere (None = invalid). The declared-divergence list (D6) lives inside the test. A failure names the pattern, the subject, both verdicts and the seed (AI_DIFF_SEED, default 20261003, printed).
